summary: Frontend-only verification of the RESTORED homepage EcosystemExperience with new CYNAIAH & VIEARTA modules. All checks passed on preview URL.
critical_code_review_comments: In EcosystemExperience.jsx the ancr platform is appended to `modules` array (line 20) AND rendered as a dedicated hub button. This creates two DOM nodes with data-testid='node-ancr' (test found 18 nodes total, 17 unique). Not a bug per requirements (~17 nodes accepted), but consider excluding ancr from the grid array to avoid duplicate testids.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Homepage ecosystem section restored with EcosystemExperience. All 17 required module nodes present (ancr hub + 16 modules). node-cynaiah and node-viearta render with logos loaded (naturalWidth>0) and Coming Soon detail panel. ANCR detail shows operating system content. Branch filters, explore-btn -> /platform, no console errors, no horizontal overflow at 1440/1024/768/390. Regression testids (hero, intelligence-*, learning-platform-link, challenge-section/threshold) all present. Note: data-testid='node-ancr' appears twice in DOM (hub + module grid) — 18 total node-* elements.
